_freeze_statement: Eligibility → intervention → expected determining set → scoring interpretation are frozen before any Phase-B trajectory is observed. The universe is the complete A–E eligible set (n=10). Do not add/remove IDs or rewrite I because an episode failed or ΔS moved the wrong way. A QEMU/tooling failure is a failed execution, not a reason to change I and retry to rescue the task.
_universe: All 10 A–E eligible tasks. Not 15. Expanding past this set requires a new pre-registered eligibility rule.
_models: B.1 validate 10 interventions. B.2 Claude / GPT / Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on the same 10. B.3 9B/Flash ablation only. Do not require 30/30 DONE.
